mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate rise above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units combined with rising industrial production above 100 index signals a fragile economic shift from residential to manufacturing, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime (UNRATE below 5.0% and INDPRO above 100), a declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances during the post-recession recovery regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, increasing corporate revenues and stock valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS is rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 index indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening residential market, reducing consumer confidence and construction-related corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE below 4.0% and payroll growth above 158,000 thousand), a high level of employment growth (PAYEMS) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances during the tight labor market regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
